text: The largest tree-cover loss event recorded on the property occurred in 2020, with a loss area of 67.7 hectares. This information is derived from the Hansen GFC GFC-2025-v1.13 data, which tracks tree-cover loss events before the 2020-12-31 baseline. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or more were detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025.
